Publish only if extract, transform, load, quality states pass, transform.input_dataset=extract.output_dataset, load.input_dataset=transform.output_dataset, quality.subject_dataset=load.output_dataset, consent.state=approved, and consent.approved_output=load.output_dataset. Otherwise hold with the exact sorted set of extract, transform, load, quality, link_transform, link_load, quality_scope, approval, approval_scope for failed conditions. Return target_id=load.output_dataset. Apply the late event first.
